subject.title: feat(control-ui): add cron calendar timeline view

question: Should maintainers accept a narrow 24-hour cron timeline slice now, or require a broader calendar design before anyone ports this PR to the current cron page?
rationale: The requested feature is new Control UI product surface, the current branch is conflicting and narrower than the canonical issue, and the remaining path is not a small safe repair on the existing branch.

options.title: Port Narrow Timeline First
options.body: Accept the 24-hour strip as a first slice, require a clean current-main port, and track daily/week/calendar editing scope separately.

options.title: Require Full Calendar Design
options.body: Pause this branch until the daily, weekly, quick-stats, validation, and rescheduling behavior is specified together.

options.title: Close This Direction
options.body: Decline the core cron calendar/timeline feature and close the PR plus the linked product issue after a maintainer decision.

recommendation.title: Port Narrow Timeline First
recommendation.body: Accept the 24-hour strip as a first slice, require a clean current-main port, and track daily/week/calendar editing scope separately.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc owns the strongest current-main integration signal for the refactored cron page and status surface that this branch must be ported onto.
